text:
Maria: Heads-up — planning a short smoke run for continuous-batching tuning tomorrow 09:30 PST. Goal: validate max_batch and queueing heuristics don't regress P99 latency for small requests. Need volunteers + quick review of the sweep configs.

Liam: I can run loadgen and collect traces. Which payloads do you want? short chat turns or longer completion tokens?

Maria: Mostly short chat-like requests (~20-50 tokens) and a gated set of long tail (500–1024) for saturation cases. Keep the ratio 80/20 short/long.

Devon: I'll double-check the autotuner flags. Quick ask: are we testing with kv-cache warmup enabled? That changes batch packing behavior.

Maria: Yes, test both: warmup=true and warmup=false. Label runs accordingly. Also capture token-rate and gpu-util per worker.

Jen (sre): Add these metrics to the smoke dashboard: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/s, gpu_util, batch_size_histogram, queue_time_ms. If we see queue_time_ms > 30ms at p95 fail early.

Kevin: Quick code-review note for the sweep script — can you include an env toggle for `MAX_TOKENS` and `MAX_BATCH` so I can iterate without rebuilding containers? Example snippet I used:
```bash
export MAX_TOKENS=512
export MAX_BATCH=32
python infra/sweeps/run_batch_sweep.py --profile --out /tmp/sweep-512-32
```

Maria: perfect. I'll push a short RFC in the PR with those env vars. PR link in thread when ready.

Liam: infra note — we should run the smoke on the staging pool with a 10% canary traffic to avoid saturating other jobs. I'll reserve 2 gpus and tag the job `cb-smoke-2951237890`.

InfraBot: Job reserved: cb-smoke-2951237890 on staging-pool (2 x a100). ETA: 09:28 PST.

Devon: For the profiling: please capture a few sample KV cache heatmaps and the per-step kernel selection logs. Add `--dump-kernels` flag to the runtime invocation so we can see fallback paths.

Maria: noted. Also, let's run two max_batch values: 8 and 32, and max_tokens: 256 and 1024. That gives 4 combos. We'll do short/long payload mix for each.

Jen (sre): I'll wire up a quick alert rule: if p99 latency increases >10% relative to baseline tag `stable-2950` mark a regression. We want automatic rollback guidance in the runbook.

Kevin: Code-review Q — after the sweep completes, can we auto-generate a CSV summary with columns: run_id, max_batch, max_tokens, p50, p95, p99, tokens_per_sec, avg_gpu_util, queue_time_p95? makes triage easier.

Maria: yes. I'll add a small reporter in the PR.

Liam: Running the canary at 09:30. I'll post the short command I'm executing in here so others can repro.

Liam: `python infra/loadgen/run.py --workload chat_short_long_mix.json --duration 10m --tag cb-smoke-2951237890`

Maria: Thanks — volunteers: @Liam run loadgen, @Devon toggle runtime flags and capture kernels, @Kevin review PR and reporter, @Jen set alert. If anyone else wants to shadow, join at 09:25 for preflight. :thumbsup:

Kevin: will review PR before 09:20.

Devon: 09:25 preflight ack.

InfraBot: Canary job started 09:30:15 PST — logs available at https://staging-logs/redwood/cb-smoke-2951237890

Maria: I'll watch the smoke dashboard. If anything looks off, we'll abort and iterate. Thanks all! :rocket:
